notes: The exercise library was re-checked against its open data source: movements that were listed with the wrong equipment (a machine filed as a mat) or missing a muscle group they train (a shoulder press with no shoulder) now carry the right ones
Five movements you can do with or without a weight — box squat, good morning, sumo squat, single-leg RDL and single-leg hamstring curl — now count a set whether or not you logged a load
Limber 11 and Seated Knee Extension with Overpressure now track as mobility, and Snap Down counts toward Power
